svg.title: R031 source-follower charging waveform
svg.desc: RK4 integration of the square-law charging equation including body effect. The voltage rises continuously from 1 V toward 1.96520 V. Example parameters are stated in the graph.
svg.text: Example: β = 1 mA/V², C₁ = 1 pF; no channel-length modulation or parasitics
t < 0: cutoff, V_X = 1 V; t > 0: saturation while conducting
Solid curve: integrated charging equation with body effect; dashed line: asymptote.
Other β and C₁ rescale time by C₁/β; the late-time voltage error is proportional to 1/t.
